text.p: Comdial Corp director of investor relations Dick Bucci said Tuesday that Comdial expects a "positive year."
He noted that Rodman & Renshaw had since February issued a first quarter estimate of $0.05 a share but that the firm's full year prediction had not changed.
Rodman & Renshaw analyst Vincent Glinski said he made the $0.05 per share estimate February 12 but at that time he maintained his $0.60 per share full-year 1997 estimate.
Glinski said he still saw an "up year."
Earlier, Comdial said it was "generally comfortable" with analysts' first quarter estimates published since February and with consensue estimates for 1997 as a whole.
For all of 1996, Comdial reported earnings of $1,809,000 or $0.21 per share, after a $736,000 or $0.08 per share credit for a deferred tax adjustment.
